dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: How long have you been noticing your heart racing?

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: It started during a very stressful week at work.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: How long does each episode last?

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Do the episodes happen while exercising?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. They sometimes happen when I am just sitting at my desk.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He has been working late almost every evening.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: How much coffee do you drink?

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: Sometimes more when he works late.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: But he becomes anxious when his heart starts racing.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: That makes sense. We will check your pulse, blood pressure, and heart rhythm, and we should also consider the amount of caffeine and stress.
